title: Masquerade Melody
description: A surreal painting features a woman's face merging with a colorful Venetian mask, her long hair transforming into flowing musical staves and notes. Below, a family sits together on a couch in a living room watching TV, while above them rises a dark gothic castle against a red and green sky with fireworks and stars.
prompt: Surreal symbolic artwork showing a young woman with long flowing brown hair whose face is half covered by a vibrant red, blue and gold masquerade mask with leaf details. Her hair morphs into swirling musical notes and staves that wrap around the composition. In the lower section a family of four sits on a couch in a living room watching television. A dark gothic castle silhouette rises in the background against a dramatic red and green sky with fireworks and stars. Ornate swirling patterns and blue flowers complete the scene.
